$notes.about: Every number that shapes how flight feels. Units: metres, seconds, radians. Read by the web game and the Godot port.
$notes.minFlightSpeed: m/s, flight never drops below this
$notes.hoverThreshold: m/s below which braking settles into a hover
$notes.diveBonus: extra m/s a steep dive can add
$notes.gravityShare: how strongly gravity speeds dives and slows climbs
$notes.yawRateSlow: rad/s at full stick, cruise speed
$notes.yawRateFast: rad/s at full stick, boost speed
$notes.yawResponse: 1/s, how quickly the turn rate follows the stick
$notes.pitchMax: rad, the attitude reached at full stick (~69°)
$notes.worldRadius: m, where the gentle turn-back begins
$notes.boomSpeedShare: shockwave fires past this share of boostSpeed
$notes.smashSpeedKept: share of speed kept when bursting through a building
